keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «아기 고양이가 나무에서 못 내려온다(문제)» 와 «남을 돕는 데 초능력은 필요 없다(교훈)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (the kitten is stuck in a tree) and the lesson (you do not need superpowers to help others). The green sentences are the answers.

qs.q: Why is the little girl crying?
opts: Her kitten is stuck in a tree.
She cannot find her red cape.
evs: Her kitten is stuck in a tree.
Sam puts on his red cape.
He brings a ladder from the park office.
You do not need superpowers to help others.
why: «Her kitten is stuck in a tree.» 아기 고양이가 나무에서 못 내려와서 울고 있어요.
Her kitten is stuck in a tree, so she is crying.

qs.q: "Her kitten is stuck in a tree." What does "stuck" mean here?
qs.qko: «Her kitten is stuck in a tree.» 에서 «stuck» 은 무슨 뜻일까요?
evs: He climbs up slowly and gets the kitten.
"You are a real hero!" says the girl.
why: «He climbs up slowly and gets the kitten.» 샘이 올라가서 데려와야 했어요. 그러니 «stuck» 은 혼자 내려오지 못한다는 뜻이에요.
Sam has to climb up and get the kitten. So "stuck" means the kitten cannot get down by itself.

qs.q: How does Sam save the kitten?
opts: He brings a ladder and climbs up to get it.
He flies up into the tree.
He calls the kitten, and it jumps down.
evs: He brings a ladder from the park office.
He climbs up slowly and gets the kitten.
At the park, a little girl is crying.
why: 공원 사무실에서 사다리를 가져오고(«He brings a ladder from the park office.»), 천천히 올라가서 고양이를 데려와요(«He climbs up slowly and gets the kitten.»). 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
He brings a ladder, and then he climbs up and gets the kitten. You need both sentences.

ends: Sam finds a lost puppy and helps it get home.
샘이 길 잃은 강아지를 찾아 집에 데려다준다.
Super Sam and the Lost Puppy
The girl puts on a cape and helps people with Sam.
여자아이도 망토를 두르고 샘과 함께 사람들을 돕는다.

write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «할 수 없는 일 + 대신 할 수 있는 일» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what you can’t do and what you can do instead in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: 두 칸 모두 «하는 일» 낱말로 시작하게 써 보세요. (예: play soccer, draw a picture)
write.moreEn: One more step: start both blanks with an action word. (e.g. play soccer, draw a picture)
write.src: “I can’t <u>fly</u>, but I can <u>bring a ladder</u>.”
